summary.text: Sam Graves represents Missouri's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House and chairs the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Tarkio, Missouri, in 1963, and describes himself as a sixth-generation family farmer and small businessman.
Graves earned a degree in agronomy from the University of Missouri-Columbia, and was elected to the Missouri House in 1992 and the state Senate in 1994.
